performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real; 3-day trend shows zero purchases since Aug 15.

findings.text: ROAS fell 81% WoW to 3.54 (28d); last 3 days (Aug 16–18) recorded 0 purchases vs 3 purchases in prior 3 days (Aug 13–15) — confirmed conversion stoppage.
Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 (due 2026-08-14) has no completion record — fresh creative pipeline is stalled, directly worsening fatigue risk.

Top campaign 'BWS - Muslim Subscription Box' consumed $849.92 of $1,501.13 (57%) in 28d; purchases are lumpy (4 on Aug 3, 6 on Aug 11, then zero) — spend is running but conversion momentum has not sustained.
GBP actions dropped 52.94% WoW; last 4 data points (Aug 15–18) show zero GBP actions — local demand signal has gone dark, compounding paid underperformance.
GA4 sessions up 13.54% WoW (avg ~215/day last 3 days) while purchases are zero — traffic is arriving but not converting, pointing to a landing page or offer mismatch, not an audience reach problem.

suggestions.text: Hold spend flat on Muslim Subscription Box campaign; confirm whether 0 purchases over 3 days (Aug 16–18) persists before any budget move.
suggestions.monday_update: The top campaign (BWS - Muslim Subscription Box) spent $849.92 in 28 days but recorded zero purchases Aug 16–18 after a 3.54 ROAS (28d) and an 81% WoW ROAS drop. Hold daily budget flat at ~$55/day and do not scale. Success check: if purchases resume and 3-day ROAS recovers above 3.0x by 2026-08-22, re-evaluate scaling; if still zero, escalate to a budget-shift or kill decision at next check.

suggestions.text: Audit landing page for the Subscription Box offer; GA4 shows ~215 sessions/day with 0 purchases — isolate page or offer as conversion blocker.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions averaged ~215/day Aug 16–18 while purchases were zero, confirming traffic is arriving but not converting. Review the landing page CTA, pricing display, and checkout flow for the Muslim Subscription Box offer — specifically check if the 100%-off test code (ihbp8pmtn8) or any Shopify conflict is suppressing real purchase events. Success check: at least 1 confirmed purchase firing correctly in Meta Events Manager within 3 days of the fix (by 2026-08-22).

suggestions.text: Escalate overdue Live-Cooking Shoot 1 (due Aug 14) to unblock new creative; current fatigue is confirmed by flat spend with zero 3-day purchases.
suggestions.monday_update: The Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 milestone was due 2026-08-14 and has no completion record, stalling the fresh creative pipeline. With zero purchases Aug 16–18 and known fatigue patterns from the test phase (retargeting frequency 11.5–24.4x on small pools), new real-footage creative is the primary lever available. Escalate to Nacer (Ops) immediately for a rescheduled shoot date; success check is confirmed footage delivery to the Video board by 2026-08-26.
